answer_1.quote: We exploit Large Language Models as knowledge bases to enrich given full phrases, so that the target word is disambiguated by incorporating more context, addressing even cases that the ambiguous word is unknown to the retrieval module.
answer_1.outputs: enhanced phrases, retrieved images, QA answers with explanations

answer_2.quote: All our approaches are evaluated on the VWSD test split using Accuracy and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) metrics.

answer_3.quote: Based on the zero-shot question-answering setting of , we incorporate the given phrase t within a question template, providing 10 answer choices from A to J that correspond to extracted captions c i from the candidate images i = A, B, ..., J for each t.
